deal_value.notes: $85M cash at closing plus up to $205M of additional cash earn-out potential tied to Walker & Dunlop's 'Drive to 25' appraisal-revenue, SBL-volume, and mortgage-banking goals (up to $290M total potential)

inputs: $85M cash + up to $205M earn-out — Walker & Dunlop press release, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/walker--dunlop-acquires-geophy-to-accelerate-technology-driven-businesses-301476206.html
calculable.caveats: GeoPhy standalone revenue/ARR/EBITDA was never publicly disclosed; searches of the press release, 8-K exhibit, and trade coverage found no target financials

sources.title: Walker & Dunlop Acquires GeoPhy to Accelerate Technology-Driven Businesses (PR Newswire)
Walker & Dunlop Acquires GeoPhy for $85M Plus $205M Earn-Out Potential (Connect CRE)
Wilson Sonsini Advises GeoPhy on $85 Million Acquisition by Walker & Dunlop

notes: 'Walker Dunlap' in the source list confirmed as a typo for Walker & Dunlop (NYSE: WD). Announced February 7, 2022; closed February 28, 2022. Deal value is public but no GeoPhy financial metric (revenue/ARR/EBITDA) was found in any public source, so no multiple can be computed. Earn-out is contingent on acquirer business goals, not target financials, further muddying any effective total consideration.
